examples.text:
Dear colleagues, 

there is a personal issue in our team structure that I need to share with you. I work in my current team for about nine years now and my current manager is with us for about seven years. At first, I got to know her as a fair and honourable person. 
But in the past few years, I have witnessed again and again that my manager is favouring a certain colleague in our team. 
My suspicion was first raised when that colleague was promoted to T3 way before her peers even though she does not take more responsibility than average or shows significantly better result. Plus, although it is important for everyone in the team to regularly attend conferences, the favourited colleage gets to attend these conferences at least twice as often as other colleagues in our team. 
There are many other examples that strengthed my suspicion and I do not want to go into details now. 
I am not sure how to address this properly. I have not confronted my manager or my colleague about this. But I definitely do not want to leave this unadressed. Could you please help me / us as a team to address this issue in the right way? 

Kind regards, 
Gerta Wernecke

I recently learned after an informal discussion with a co-worker that they were paid way more than myself for the same job. We have the same educational background and the only difference I can see is our gender. 
Can you provide a clear justification about this salary difference ?
Thanks in advance,
Best Regards,
M. Anguita
examples.subject: Request for explanation for gender pay gap of 22.6%

examples.text: Hi John,  I'm taking up a fellowship at Waco. I've been trying to check for some good accomdation in the location from here virtually, however, I'm unable to finalize them. Since this project is expected to complete in 6 months' timeframe, is it possible that I could share the apartment that you're currently renting, provided the landlord and the laws allow it. I'd happy to share expenses of the apartment and help in upkeeping the place to the best. Awaiting to hear your thoughts! Regards, William Allen
examples.subject: Information request about accommodation at Waco

examples.text: Hi, My son just completed his graduation in the United States and his graduation day is on Nov 15, 2022. He is expecting me to be around for his special day. With this, I'd need about 15 days' time off to attend his graduation day along with a bit of travelling. In between, I'd be connecting to work from the Dec 1st - Dec 8th as we discusssed. Thanks, Jean Ferreira
examples.subject: Request time off due to the graduation of my son

examples.text: Hi, I've a physio consultation appoinment on  June 5, 2016 which includes a detailed study and further action at the doctor's office. This would require for me to take at least two days' sick leave related to the visit and further steps. Please do approve my sick leave for two days starting June 5th. Regards, Michael Jackson
examples.subject: Request for sick leave for 2 days

examples.text: Hi, Off late, I've been facing pain in the back, which were not relieved with the regular medications. I've had to make an appointment with an Orthopedician for consultation. After a detailed set of tests, it was concluded that I've Osteoporosis, a condition that causes bones to become weak and fragile. I've been asked to take extra care while I continue with my day-to-day activiites. I'd need, at first, sick leaves for about 7 days (starting August 19, 2018) to get better with the condition and to undergo initial treatment at the hospital, and then rest at home before I resume my work back. Thank you! Regards, Eric Atkins
examples.subject: Request for sick leave for 7 days

examples.text: Hi, This is to let you know that my partner and I have been confirmed to be pregnant. We're elated that our dream finally came true. I'd need to take off for about a week's time to enjoy this special moment with my partner and alll our near and dear ones in additon to paying a visit to the doctor's office for some regular tests. Kindly approve my leave starting tomorrow until a week from now. Thank you! Regards, Fredo Filangieri
examples.subject: Request time off due to the pregnancy of my partner

examples.text: Hi, This email is to request for refund of my air travel for my business travel on the June 1, 2021. As you know, I visited a customer site while I attended the annual conference at San Jose. Kindly approve my travel refund for the travel on June 1, 2021 from Las Vegas to Norman Y. Mineta San Jose International Airport. Thank you! Rodney Strong
examples.subject: Request of refund for plane ticket from Las Vegas to San Jose at 01/06/2021

examples.text: Hi, Last evening I developed acute abdominal cramp, which suddenly became unbearable. I visited the doctor's office and with the elevated enzyme levels they diagnosed that I've had an acute pancreatitis. Currently, I'm admitted at the hospital on medications intravenously. I'd need to be at the hospital before I'm better to be discharged from here. I'd need to apply for sick leave for about 6 days starting Dec 12, 2016 onwards. Kindly approve my sick leave. I'd submit all the necessary medical records once I'm back home discharged from the hospital. Thank you! Regards, Lori Rodriguez
examples.subject: Request for sick leave for 6 days

examples.text: Hi Marcia, How have you been doing? I write to you to request for time off for our family reunion. My son, daughter along with their spouses are home for Christmas early this year and we are planning for a family reunion with my brother and his family. We're planning to host this event in our house and I'd need time off for prep and be a good host. Kindly approve my leave. Best Regards, Isabel Stiebitz
examples.subject: Request time off due to a family reunion

examples.text: Hi, I've my semester exams during the last week of November. I'd like to avail my examination leave for preparation and studies for 12 days starting November 15, 2022. Kindly approve the same. Regards, Ennio Ughi

examples.text: Good morning, I'm writing because I would need some time off, I recently had some problems with my spouse and we are trying to get back on track together. Therefore I would need to focus fully on it. Thanks for your understanding. Celine.

examples.subject: Information request about accommodation at Ontario

Thank you for your understanding. Regards, Ludmilla

I am looking forward to hear back from you. Best, Paulino
